goal: Build a tiny spreadsheet engine in plain Node.js (CommonJS, no packages): cells hold numbers or formulas such as =SUM(A1:A3)*2, and the sheet computes them.

tasks.title: Tokenizer (tokenize.js)
tasks.detail: Write tokenize.js exporting tokenize(formula). The judging test shows the exact token shapes.

tasks.title: Cell references (cells.js)
tasks.detail: Write cells.js exporting parseRef(ref) and expandRange(range). The judging test shows the exact shapes.

tasks.title: Functions (functions.js)
tasks.detail: Write functions.js exporting FUNCTIONS, an object of spreadsheet functions on flat lists of numbers.

tasks.title: Parser (parse.js)
tasks.detail: Write parse.js exporting parse(tokens), using the tokens from tokenize.js, into the tree shape the judging test shows.

tasks.title: Evaluator (evaluate.js)
tasks.detail: Write evaluate.js exporting evaluate(tree, getCell), using cells.js for ranges and functions.js for function calls.

tasks.title: Sheet (sheet.js)
tasks.detail: Write sheet.js exporting the class Sheet that ties everything together, with error values for division by zero, unknown names and cycles.
